text: pptwise 是面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 的演示文稿插件，通过注册 deck-generation skill 和专用工具，让 AI 在本地项目里规划并生成可编辑的 PowerPoint。它提供大纲校验、主题墙预览、单次构建检查与幻灯片预览，也能搜索图库并把联系表交给支持图片输入的模型查看。适合希望用自然语言制作和检查 PPT 的 DSH 用户；本地渲染无需 API key，图库搜索可选配置服务凭据。

pptwise helps DSH users create editable PowerPoint decks locally. Its skill guides deck creation; tools validate outlines, compare themes, build decks, preview slides in chat, and search stock photos. Local rendering needs no API key; photo search can use optional provider credentials.
想让 DSH 帮我做一份能在 PowerPoint 里继续编辑的演示文稿
有没有办法先看大纲和主题效果，再开始逐页做 PPT？
我希望 AI 生成幻灯片后，能直接在对话里预览
帮我检查整份演示文稿并指出需要修改的页面
怎样给 AI 做的 deck 选择合适的视觉主题？
我需要给幻灯片找配图，并预览候选图片
I want my DSH assistant to create an editable PowerPoint deck locally.
Can I compare presentation themes and review slides inside the chat?
pptwise 的功能「对话内预览」：把 deck 项目或 IR JSON 交给预览工具，在会话中查看逐页幻灯片；结果带页面数和检查提示。
pptwise 的功能「主题墙」：输入封面标题、场合或指定主题，展示多种主题的封面与内容页样例，便于制作前挑选。
pptwise 的功能「构建检查」：构建工具返回状态、问题和警告；检查通过时给出 PowerPoint 路径，也可附整套页面联系表。
pptwise 的功能「大纲检查」：校验 deck.spec.json，通过时列出每页类型、标题和摘要；无效时返回错误与警告。
pptwise 的功能「图库搜索」：用简短英文关键词和可选画幅搜索图片，返回尺寸、作者、许可及编号联系表，并可固定所选图片。
pptwise 本地渲染不需 API key；图库搜索可选使用 Pexels、Pixabay 或 Openverse 凭据。联系表在模型支持图片输入且附件服务可用时直接附上，否则返回文件路径。

@liustack/pptwise README · What it makes：One page from the sample deck of each of the 24 themes, then eight up close, all rendered by the engine. Every sample pages through in full on [pptwise.com](https://pptwise.com/#samples), with its .pptx to download. In the exported file every heading, chart bar, label, and card is a native PowerPoint shape with editable text.

@liustack/pptwise README · Talk to us：Issues are welcome any time. [Open one](https://github.com/liustack/pptwise/issues/new/choose), or follow **[@liustack](https://x.com/liustack)** on X. Share what you made with PPTwise, which harness you use, and what the next release should solve. New releases land there first.

@liustack/pptwise README · Highlights：**⚡ Tell your AI what to cover, get the deck.** You bring the intent, the engine turns semantic page kinds and typed components into a coherent theme-bound deck. The same bound input renders the same output every time.

@liustack/pptwise README · Highlights：**✏️ Open it in PowerPoint and keep working.** Every heading, bullet, and chart bar opens in PowerPoint for you to retype and restyle. Chart and table figures are the exception: every bar and cell is an editable shape with editable text, not a native PowerPoint chart or table object carrying data, so to change the numbers, have your AI rebuild that page. Start from 24 factory themes, copy one into your workspace, or extract colors and fonts from a deck your company already uses.

@liustack/pptwise README · Highlights：**🔌 Installs into the agent you already use.** One command puts PPTwise into DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, or any agent that reads a skill folder (Codex and friends), and it knows how to build a deck the moment it lands.

**🔁 Revisions without describing everything again.** One command opens a live preview in your browser. Tell your AI what to change in plain words, and the page refreshes itself as each revision lands.

@liustack/pptwise README · Highlights：**🔒 No account, no API key to render, no network at render time.** Install it and it works. Node 22.19+ or Bun is all you need on the machine. Optional stock-photo search uses the user's own Pexels key.

@liustack/pptwise README · Install：> Install PPTwise following https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liustack/pptwise/main/INSTALL-dsh.md, then run the health check and tell me the result.

**Adding it yourself in DeepSeek Harness Desktop?** Open **Plugins**, choose **Add plugin**, and enter the package name `@liustack/pptwise@0.49.0`, not the GitHub address. The GitHub source does not carry the built engine, so a plugin added from it installs but cannot make a deck.

@liustack/pptwise README · Install：There is no step 2. Your AI puts the skill folder where your harness reads it, and the skill brings its own version-pinned launcher, so there is no CLI to install by hand. PPTwise renders a PPTX entirely locally: no API key, no account, nothing to configure for render. Optional stock-photo search needs the user's own Pexels key. The only prerequisite is Node 22.19+ (or Bun).

@liustack/pptwise README · Quick start：IR v5 is one JSON file describing a complete bound deck. Every content page names its semantic `kind`. The theme menu turns that kind into a visual face.

```json
{
  "version": "5",
  "filename": "hello.pptx",
  "theme": { "id": "brief" },

Save that as `deck.json`, then run:

```bash
pptwise validate deck.json
pptwise render deck.json -o out/hello.pptx
pptwise preview deck.json -o out/review --html
```

@liustack/pptwise README · Quick start：Choose a theme from `pptwise themes --json` by matching `occasions` and `identity`. Compare two to four candidates before binding:

```bash
pptwise theme try brief,swiss,memo
```

Create a complete independent v2 theme by copying a preset, forking a palette, or extracting an Office brand:

@liustack/pptwise README · Quick start：```bash
pptwise theme new --from brief -o themes/acme.theme.json --id acme
pptwise theme fork acme --primary "#0B5FFF" -o themes/acme-blue.theme.json --id acme-blue
pptwise brand extract corp.pptx -o themes/acme-brand.theme.json --id acme-brand --from brief
```

@liustack/pptwise README · Quick start：A deck project binds one theme in `deck.spec.json`, then keeps page content in `pages/<id>.json`. Render has no temporary theme switch. A same-menu color fork can replace the binding. A different menu requires returning to theme selection, then revisiting the spec and affected page fills.

No install also works: `npx -y @liustack/pptwise validate deck.json`. In a source checkout, use `node dist/cli.js` in place of `pptwise`. Ready-made v5 files live under `examples/`.

@liustack/pptwise README · Quick start：| command | purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `spec validate <spec.json>` | Validate page order, kinds, headings, narrative, and theme-menu fit. |
| `assemble <dir>` | Combine a deck project into derived IR v5 without storing rendering choices. |
| `validate <target>` | Check IR, binding, menu, components, assets, and content quality. |
| `render <target> [-o <out.pptx>]` | Render native editable PPTX. |
| `audit <target>` | Check geometry, contrast, truncation, dropped content, and monotony. |
| `preview <target> [--html]` | Write SVG pages and an optional self-contained review file. |
| `serve <target>` | Start a live review that reloads on source changes. |
| `themes [--json]` | List factory themes with occasion and identity metadata. |
| `theme try <id,id,...>` | Compare the fixed sample across two to four themes. |
| `theme new`, `theme fork` | Copy a complete theme or create a full-palette fork. |
| `doctor` | Check runtime, skill copies, optional capabilities, and a self-test render. |

@liustack/pptwise README · 亮点：**⚡ 跟 AI 说一句，PPT 就好了。** 你给出意图，引擎把语义讲法与类型化组件做成一份主题统一的 deck。同一份绑定输入每次都会渲成同一份结果。

**✏️ 打开就能接着改。** 每个标题、每条要点、每根柱子都能在 PowerPoint 里点开改字改色。图表和表格里的数字是例外：每根柱子、每个格子都是可编辑的形状和文字，不是带数据的 PowerPoint 原生图表或表格对象，换数字让 AI 重做一版。可以从 24 个出厂主题起步，拷进工作区继续改，也能从公司现有 PPT 抽取配色与字体。

**🔌 装进你正在用的 agent。** 一条命令装进 DeepSeek Harness、Claude Code，或任何读 skill 文件夹的 agent（Codex 等），装完就会用。

**🔁 改稿不用重新描述一遍。** 一条命令打开实时预览网页，用一句话告诉 AI 要改哪里，改完网页自动刷新。

**🔒 不用注册、渲染不用配 key、渲染时不联网。** 装好就能用，电脑上有 Node 22.19+ 或 Bun 就行。可选的图库搜索用用户自己的 Pexels key。

@liustack/pptwise README · 安装：没有第二步。你的 AI 会把 skill 文件夹放到你这个 harness 读取的位置，skill 自带钉死版本的启动器，不需要你手动装 CLI。PPTwise 在本地渲染 PPTX：渲染不要 API key、不用注册、无需配置。可选的图库搜索需要用户自己的 Pexels key。唯一前置是 Node 22.19+（或 Bun）。

@liustack/pptwise README · 快速开始：IR v5 是一份描述完整绑定 deck 的 JSON 文件。每张内容页都要写明语义 `kind`，主题菜单再把这个 kind 变成视觉脸。

```json
{
  "version": "5",
  "filename": "hello.pptx",
  "theme": { "id": "brief" },

保存为 `deck.json`，然后运行：

```bash
pptwise validate deck.json
pptwise render deck.json -o out/hello.pptx
pptwise preview deck.json -o out/review --html
```

按 `pptwise themes --json` 的 `occasions` 与 `identity` 选择主题。绑定前可以比较两到四个候选：

```bash
pptwise theme try brief,swiss,memo
```

可以通过拷贝预设、创建配色分叉，或抽取 Office 品牌，得到完整独立的 v2 主题：

@liustack/pptwise README · 快速开始：```bash
pptwise theme new --from brief -o themes/acme.theme.json --id acme
pptwise theme fork acme --primary "#0B5FFF" -o themes/acme-blue.theme.json --id acme-blue
pptwise brand extract corp.pptx -o themes/acme-brand.theme.json --id acme-brand --from brief
```

Deck 项目在 `deck.spec.json` 中绑定唯一主题，再把页面内容放进 `pages/<id>.json`。渲染阶段没有临时主题切换。菜单相同的配色分叉可以替换绑定。菜单不同则需要回到主题选择，再修订 spec、受影响的 kind 与页面填充。

@liustack/pptwise README · 快速开始：不安装也能运行：`npx -y @liustack/pptwise validate deck.json`。源码仓库中用 `node dist/cli.js` 代替 `pptwise`。`examples/` 下有可直接尝试的 v5 文件。

最常用的命令：

@liustack/pptwise README · 快速开始：| command | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `spec validate <spec.json>` | 验证页面顺序、kind、标题、叙事与主题菜单适配。 |
| `assemble <dir>` | 把 deck 项目组合成派生 IR v5，不保存渲染选择。 |
| `validate <target>` | 检查 IR、绑定、菜单、组件、资产与内容质量。 |
| `render <target> [-o <out.pptx>]` | 渲染原生可编辑 PPTX。 |
| `audit <target>` | 检查几何、对比度、截断、内容丢失与单调性。 |
| `preview <target> [--html]` | 写出 SVG 页面与可选的自包含评审文件。 |
| `serve <target>` | 启动随源文件变化自动刷新的实时评审。 |
| `themes [--json]` | 列出带场合与个性强度元数据的出厂主题。 |
| `theme try <id,id,...>` | 用两到四个主题对比固定样稿。 |
| `theme new`、`theme fork` | 拷贝完整主题，或创建整套配色分叉。 |
| `doctor` | 检查运行时、skill 副本、可选能力与自检渲染。 |
